seal.statement: Every producer whose answer a consumer probes for a promise shape (typeof x.then, typeof x.catch, optional-chained or truthiness forms, instanceof Promise) answers one shape on every path: an I/O producer (transport sends, service command routing) returns a promise unconditionally, a synchronous-when-possible turn (the raft runtime's internal turn and the operation port's protocol answers, the serialized replica-mutation lane) returns a named settled-or-pending answer produced once at the producer so that no timing changes, and a service's apply mode is declared and validated once at registration instead of sniffed per entry; the consumer-side probes are deleted, and the pattern becomes an ESLint no-restricted-syntax selector so a value-or-promise return cannot reappear.
